title: Smart Data Models - Catena-X - SingleLevelUsageAsPlanned
description:
The aspect provides the information in which parent part(s)/product(s)the given item is to be assembled into or used. This could be a 1:1 relationship in terms of a e.g. a brake component or 1:n for e.g. coatings. The given item as well as the parent item must refer to an object from the as-planned lifecycle phase.
If multiple versions of parent parts exist that the child part can be assembled into or used, all versions of the parent part are included in the usage list. (Catena-X aspect model urn:samm:io.catenax.industry_core.single_level_usage_as_planned:3.0.0#SingleLevelUsageAsPlanned, translated from the SAMM-generated JSON Schema; aspect property names and nested structures are kept verbatim.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity. Built as urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<UUID of the Catena-X digital twin (globalAssetId without the urn:uuid: prefix)>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SingleLevelUsageAsPlanned'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

parentItems.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.industry_core.single_level_usage_as_planned:3.0.0#parentItems'. Set of parent parts, in which the given child object will be assembled into or used (one structural level up).

items.description: globalAssetId and meta data of the parent part.

quantity.description: Quantity of which the child part will be assembled into or used in the parent part.

value.description: The quantity value associated with the unit.

unit.description: The unit of an item. Common units may be related to mass, count, linear, area, volume or misc.

createdOn.description: Timestamp when the relation between the parent part and the child part was created

businessPartner.description: The supplier of the given child item.

globalAssetId.description: The fully anonymous ID in the dataspace of the part.

lastModifiedOn.description: Timestamp when the assembly or usage relationship between parent part and child part was last modified.

validityPeriod.description:
The period of time during which the parent-child relation is valid. This relates to whether a child part can be built into or used in the production of the parent part at a given time.
If no validity period is given the relation is considered valid at any point in time.

validFrom.description: Start date and time of validity period.

customers.description:
Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.shared.industry_core.common:1.0.0#customers'. A list of all customers of this item. If the parent items in which this item is assembled into are known, they should be listed as well.

For serialized items the list should contain only one customer with one parent item.
As different subsets of a batch might be sold to different customers this is a list.

items.description: The provided regular expression ensures that the BPNL is composed of prefix 'BPNL', 10 digits and two alphanumeric letters.

globalAssetId.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.shared.industry_core.common:1.0.0#globalAssetId'. The fully anonymous ID in the dataspace of the part.
